purpose: Official-source comparators for NYSC COURSE-017 Agricultural Machinery Equipment Mechanic. The governed catalogue publishes no module headings, so these records are shown without a competency matrix.
status_note: Source-inspected records awaiting independent human review; curricula, standards and qualifications are not evidence of programme delivery.

country_group_gaps.sri_lanka: No Sri Lankan agricultural-machinery mechanic curriculum or occupational standard with inspectable specialist competencies was verified; the agricultural-production diploma contains only an incidental machinery-maintenance module and was excluded.

records.entry_as_published: Passed 10th class examination with Science and Mathematics or its equivalent.

Service Fuel Feed System of Tractor in a workshop.
Overhaul Clutch and Gearbox of Tractor in a workshop.
Overhaul Differential and PTO Unit of Tractor in the workshop.

notes: An occupational standard and training regulation, not evidence of delivery by a named provider.
Scope is explicitly limited to four-wheel tractors; it does not establish coverage of every agricultural machine named by NYSC.
scope_verbatim: The AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY SERVICING (4-WHEEL TRACTOR) NC III Qualification consists of competencies that a person must achieve to diagnose and repair electrical systems, engine system, axle system, hydraulic system and transmission system of 4 – wheel drive tractor.

The inspected PDF is Release 4; training.gov.au lists Release 5 as current from 9 July 2026, with only additional/updated electives. Core evidence stored here is unchanged, but the release should be refreshed at human review.
Elective units are options, not evidence every learner completes them.
scope_verbatim: This qualification reflects the role of individuals who perform a broad range of tasks on a variety of agricultural machinery in the automotive retail, service and repair industry.
